text:
cheng: Quick perf sweep across GPUs (A100/H100/L40S). Ran fused-paged, flash-variant, paged-only. Seq lens 512,1024,2048,4096,8192. BSZ 1,4,8,32. H100 shows ~12-18% drop for fused-paged at seq=4096 bsz=8 vs previous baseline. Flamegraphs attached.

maya: Can you paste the exact command + model/config? Also did you check KV-cache warmup/hits?

cheng:
```
./bench_attn --model=Llama-13B --gpu=A100,H100,L40S --variants=fused-paged,flash,paged \\
  --seq=512,1024,2048,4096,8192 --bsz=1,4,8,32 --iters=100 --kv-cache=true
```
Throughput snapshot (selected):
```
H100 fused-paged seq=4096 bsz=8: 410 tok/s  (prev baseline: 480)
H100 flash         seq=4096 bsz=8: 470 tok/s
A100 fused-paged   seq=4096 bsz=8: 495 tok/s
L40S fused-paged   seq=4096 bsz=8: 320 tok/s
```

sam: We saw a similar blip on canary last week — suspect kernel selector flipped to a path that adds extra memcpy during the prefetch window. Any kernel-level timings?

cheng: Quick nvprof-like profile (top kernels, avg latency per call):
```
attn_fused_paged_kernel_v2        38.4 ms
attn_flash_mixed_kernel           30.2 ms
kv_prefetch_memcpy_h2d             4.2 ms
kv_readback_async                  3.1 ms
```

priya: KV-cache behavior? eviction spikes? prefetch window size? batch stride?

cheng: KV hit-rate dropped ~7% at the regression point (seq=4096 bsz=8). Prefetch window=8 (default), batch stride contiguous=8. Perf counters: SM util ~88%, L2 writebacks +22% vs baseline, increase in device->host traffic during warmup window.

logan: Proposal: force kernel selector to prefer flash variant on H100 for seq>=2048 for a short canary. If throughput recovers, we need a selector-bias/heuristic change rather than changing the kernels. I'll flip selector bias in canary.

ci-bot: Deployed kernel-selector canary: selector-bias=flash@h100:seq>=2048 (canary id: canary-20260317-9). Rolling to 5 hosts.

maya: Also add a microbench that isolates memcpy overhead: run fused-paged with prefetch-window=4/8/12 and measure memcpy time and KV hit-rate.

cheng: Will run microbench now and try a patch locally: reduce prefetch-window by 25% for H100 fused-paged path to see if it avoids KV thrash. If that helps, we'll push a canary patch.

sam: If the patch fixes it, add a perf regression test to the dashboard so future selector flips trigger alerts.

cheng: Uploading logs and flamegraphs to /redwood/bench/attachments/4076501234. Will post microbench results in ~2h :coffee:
